patterns.note: A persistent, fixed-position left sidebar houses primary navigation and secondary content (like releases), while the main content area scrolls independently on the right.
Extreme contrast in type scale, featuring massive, condensed display headings (e.g., 'SIKK KIDD') alongside smaller, highly legible sans-serif body text and monospaced data labels.
A dominant dark mode palette with deep black backgrounds, high-contrast white text, and subtle gray for secondary elements, accented by vibrant green for positive data indicators.
The hero section features a 3D album art element that subtly rotates and reveals more of its depth as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic visual effect, while the left sidebar remains sticky.
Data visualization is presented in a grid of distinct, dark-themed cards, each with high-contrast numerical values and clear labels, providing an at-a-glance overview of statistics.

technique_notes: Implement a fixed-position left sidebar that remains visible and interactive while the main content area scrolls independently, using CSS `position: fixed` and appropriate z-indexing.

Create a hero section where a 3D-transformed album art element subtly rotates and reveals more of its depth as the user scrolls, likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger to link scroll progress to CSS `transform` properties for rotation and perspective.
Utilize a dark color scheme with high contrast text and subtle accent colors for data visualization, applying subtle rounded corners to interactive elements and content cards for a polished feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Massive, condensed display headings (~5x body) with clean sans-serif body text and smaller monospaced labels for data.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and card elements, maintaining a generally sharp aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, creating an uncrowded and spacious feel.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its persistent, fixed left sidebar, which creates an almost desktop-application feel for a web page. This, combined with the extreme contrast in typography and the subtle 3D parallax of the hero album art, elevates it beyond a typical marketing site. If a builder copied only one idea, it should be the integrated, content-rich fixed sidebar.
